definition.title: The Last Manifest
definition.premise: Recover the record of a fatal harbor diversion, then decide whether accountability or one family's safety should own it.

roles.persona: Mara speaks in clipped inventory terms, wants the diversion exposed, and fears what exposure will do to her family.

items.name: signed cargo manifest
items.description: Mara's record of the diversion and the last paper her brother handled.

acts.title: The missing line
acts.summary: Mara's request leads to the hidden evidence.

acts.title: Who owns the truth
acts.summary: The player chooses the consequence by choosing the destination.

narrative.description: Mara names the missing cargo line and where she hid its last surviving record.
narrative.playerHint: Talk to Mara at Low Tide Cafe.
narrative.stake: Without the record, her brother remains an accounting error.

narrative.description: The signed manifest is still under the cafe counter where Mara left it.
narrative.stake: Leaving it means the evidence disappears in the next inspection.

narrative.description: The archive clerk logs the signature and the diversion becomes a public record.
narrative.playerHint: Deliver the manifest to Harbor Archive.
narrative.stake: Publication exposes the diversion and exposes Mara with it.

narrative.description: Mara takes the manifest back and seals it with the rest of her private ledger.
narrative.playerHint: Return to Mara with the manifest.
narrative.stake: Her family stays safe because the public never learns why.

endings.title: Public record
endings.epilogue: The diversion is exposed and Mara leaves before the company can answer.

endings.title: Private ledger
endings.epilogue: Mara's family stays safe and her brother remains absent from the official record.

mechanicChoices.narrativeReason: A direct exchange lets Mara's grief and request establish the player's responsibility.
mechanicChoices.cause: Mara has exhausted official channels and trusts an outsider with the missing line.
mechanicChoices.effect: The player learns where the manifest is hidden and why it matters.

transitions.consequence: The manifest becomes the next reachable objective.

mechanicChoices.narrativeReason: Physically holding the record makes possession and later delivery part of the decision.
mechanicChoices.cause: Mara disclosed the hiding place before the next inspection.
mechanicChoices.effect: The player holds the evidence and both destinations become possible.

transitions.narrativeCause: The manifest can now be submitted as evidence.
The manifest can instead be returned to Mara.
transitions.consequence: The private route opens at the same time.

mechanicChoices.narrativeReason: Delivery makes publication an enacted choice that consumes the evidence.
mechanicChoices.cause: The player chooses the public archive as the manifest's destination.
mechanicChoices.effect: The diversion enters the public record and Mara must leave.

mechanicChoices.narrativeReason: Returning to Mara makes protection a direct personal choice rather than silent inaction.
mechanicChoices.cause: The player chooses Mara over the archive while still holding the manifest.
mechanicChoices.effect: Mara seals the record and her family remains safe.

endingRoutes.cause: The player delivers the only signed copy to the archive.
endingRoutes.consequence: The diversion becomes public and Mara leaves the harbor.

endingRoutes.cause: The player returns to Mara instead of publishing the copy.
endingRoutes.consequence: Her family stays safe and the diversion remains hidden.
